verses.text: Then Job answered:
“I have heard many things like these; miserable comforters are you all.

xrefs.text: You, however, smear with lies; you are all worthless physicians.
“Should this stream of words go unanswered and such a speaker be vindicated?
How painful are honest words! But what does your argument prove?
The latter do so in love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the gospel.
“How you have helped the powerless and saved the arm that is feeble!

verses.text: Is there no end to your long-winded speeches? What provokes you to continue testifying?

xrefs.text: Do you intend to correct my words, and treat as wind my cry of despair?
“Does a wise man answer with empty counsel or fill his belly with the hot east wind?
and wholesome speech that is above reproach, so that anyone who opposes us will be ashamed, having nothing bad to say about us.
I have heard a rebuke that insults me, and my understanding prompts a reply.
No one was able to answer a word, and from that day on no one dared to question Him any further.

verses.text: I could also speak like you if you were in my place; I could heap up words against you and shake my head at you.

xrefs.text: I am an object of scorn to my accusers; when they see me, they shake their heads.
All who see me mock me; they sneer and shake their heads:
All who pass by clap their hands at you in scorn. They hiss and shake their heads at the Daughter of Jerusalem: “Is this the city that was called the perfection of beauty, the joy of all the earth?”
This is the word that the LORD has spoken against him: ‘The Virgin Daughter of Zion despises you and mocks you; the Daughter of Jerusalem shakes her head behind you.
They have made their land a desolation, a perpetual object of scorn; all who pass by will be appalled and shake their heads.

verses.text: But I would encourage you with my mouth, and the consolation of my lips would bring relief.

xrefs.text: Brothers, if someone is caught in a trespass, you who are spiritual should restore him with a spirit of gentleness. But watch yourself, or you also may be tempted.
Strengthen the limp hands and steady the feeble knees!
Oil and incense bring joy to the heart, and the counsel of a friend is sweetness to the soul.
Wait patiently for the LORD; be strong and courageous. Wait patiently for the LORD!
A despairing man should have the kindness of his friend, even if he forsakes the fear of the Almighty.

verses.text: Even if I speak, my pain is not relieved, and if I hold back, how will it go away?

xrefs.text: [“]I loathe my own life; I will express my complaint and speak in the bitterness of my soul.
From my youth I was afflicted and near death. I have borne Your terrors; I am in despair.
For the choirmaster. According to Jeduthun. A Psalm of Asaph. I cried out to God; I cried aloud to God to hear me.

verses.text: Surely He has now exhausted me; You have devastated all my family.

xrefs.text: So I am allotted months of futility, and nights of misery are appointed to me.
the Sabeans swooped down and took them away. They put the servants to the sword, and I alone have escaped to tell you!”
I loathe my life! I would not live forever. Leave me alone, for my days are but a breath.
I am weary from groaning; all night I flood my bed with weeping and drench my couch with tears.
The Lord GOD has given Me the tongue of discipleship, to sustain the weary with a word. He awakens Me morning by morning; He awakens My ear to listen as a disciple.

verses.text: You have bound me, and it has become a witness; my frailty rises up and testifies against me.

xrefs.text: You produce new witnesses against me and multiply Your anger toward me. Hardships assault me in wave after wave.
My skin and flesh cling to my bones; I have escaped by the skin of my teeth.
My knees are weak from fasting, and my body grows lean and gaunt.
I went away full, but the LORD has brought me back empty. Why call me Naomi? After all, the LORD has testified against me, and the Almighty has afflicted me.”
From the ends of the earth we hear singing: “Glory to the Righteous One.” But I said, “I am wasting away! I am wasting away! Woe is me.” The treacherous betray; the treacherous deal in treachery.

verses.text: His anger has torn me and opposed me; He gnashes His teeth at me. My adversary pierces me with His eyes.

xrefs.text: Like godless jesters at a feast, they gnashed their teeth at me.
All your enemies open their mouths against you. They hiss and gnash their teeth, saying, “We have swallowed her up. This is the day for which we have waited. We have lived to see it!”
Why do You hide Your face and consider me as Your enemy?
His anger burns against me, and He counts me among His enemies.
Come, let us return to the LORD. For He has torn us to pieces, but He will heal us; He has wounded us, but He will bind up our wounds.

verses.text: They open their mouths against me and strike my cheeks with contempt; they join together against me.

xrefs.text: But when I stumbled, they assembled in glee; they gathered together against me. Assailants I did not know slandered me without ceasing.
They open their jaws against me like lions that roar and maul.
I offered My back to those who struck Me, and My cheeks to those who tore out My beard. I did not hide My face from scorn and spittle.
Let him offer his cheek to the one who would strike him; let him be filled with reproach.
At this, the high priest Ananias ordered those standing near Paul to strike him on the mouth.

verses.text: God has delivered me to unjust men; He has thrown me to the clutches of the wicked.

xrefs.text: Do not hand me over to the will of my foes, for false witnesses rise up against me, breathing out violence.
Behold, the wicked man travails with evil; he conceives trouble and births falsehood.
You have not delivered me to the enemy; You have set my feet in the open.
One day, while Job’s sons and daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brother’s house,
For God has consigned everyone to disobedience so that He may have mercy on everyone.

verses.text: I was at ease, but He shattered me; He seized me by the neck and crushed me. He has set me up as His target;

xrefs.text: He forced me off my path and tore me to pieces; He left me without help.
If I have sinned, what have I done to You, O watcher of mankind? Why have You made me Your target, so that I am a burden to You
He has worn away my flesh and skin; He has shattered my bones.
But You have crushed us in the lair of jackals; You have covered us with deepest darkness.
For He would crush me with a tempest and multiply my wounds without cause.

verses.text: His archers surround me. He pierces my kidneys without mercy and spills my gall on the ground.

xrefs.text: It is drawn out of his back, the gleaming point from his liver. Terrors come over him.
For the arrows of the Almighty have pierced me; my spirit drinks in their poison; the terrors of God are arrayed against me.
My eyes fail from weeping; I am churning within. My heart is poured out in grief over the destruction of the daughter of my people, because children and infants faint in the streets of the city.
The archers attacked him with bitterness; they aimed at him in hostility.
It still brings me comfort, and joy through unrelenting pain, that I have not denied the words of the Holy One.

verses.text: He breaks me with wound upon wound; He rushes me like a mighty warrior.

xrefs.text: And he struck them ruthlessly with a great slaughter, and then went down and stayed in the cave at the rock of Etam.
Deep calls to deep in the roar of Your waterfalls; all Your breakers and waves have rolled over me.
For He would crush me with a tempest and multiply my wounds without cause.
They charge like mighty men; they scale the walls like men of war. Each one marches in formation, not swerving from the course.
Indeed, He keeps turning His hand against me all day long.

verses.text: I have sewn sackcloth over my skin; I have buried my horn in the dust.

xrefs.text: Then Jacob tore his clothes, put sackcloth around his waist, and mourned for his son many days.
then may my enemy pursue me and overtake me; may he trample me to the ground and leave my honor in the dust. Selah
Do not lift up your horn against heaven or speak with an outstretched neck.’”
When Ahab heard these words, he tore his clothes, put on sackcloth, and fasted. He lay down in sackcloth and walked around meekly.
On that day the Lord GOD of Hosts called for weeping and wailing, for shaven heads and the wearing of sackcloth.

verses.text: My face is red with weeping, and deep shadows ring my eyes;

xrefs.text: Then He said to them, “My soul is consumed with sorrow to the point of death. Stay here and keep watch.
For these things I weep; my eyes flow with tears. For there is no one nearby to comfort me, no one to revive my soul. My children are destitute because the enemy has prevailed.
For my days vanish like smoke, and my bones burn like glowing embers.
My eyes have grown dim with grief, and my whole body is but a shadow.
Be merciful to me, O LORD, for I am in distress; my eyes fail from sorrow, my soul and body as well.

verses.text: yet my hands are free of violence and my prayer is pure.

xrefs.text: The sacrifice of the wicked is detestable to the LORD, but the prayer of the upright is His delight.
If I had cherished iniquity in my heart, the Lord would not have listened.
I will cling to my righteousness and never let go. As long as I live, my conscience will not accuse me.
But if you would earnestly seek God and ask the Almighty for mercy,
[“]I have made a covenant with my eyes. How then could I gaze with desire at a virgin?

verses.text: O earth, do not cover my blood; may my cry for help never be laid to rest.

xrefs.text: For the blood she shed is still within her; she poured it out on the bare rock; she did not pour it on the ground to cover it with dust.
For behold, the LORD is coming out of His dwelling to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity. The earth will reveal her bloodshed and will no longer conceal her slain.
Now you are cursed and banished from the ground, which has opened its mouth to receive your brother’s blood from your hand.
If I had cherished iniquity in my heart, the Lord would not have listened.
O land, land, land, hear the word of the LORD!

verses.text: Even now my witness is in heaven, and my advocate is on high.

xrefs.text: God, whom I serve with my spirit in preaching the gospel of His Son, is my witness how constantly I remember you
If you mistreat my daughters or take other wives, although no one is with us, remember that God is a witness between you and me.”
Samuel said to them, “The LORD is a witness against you, and His anointed is a witness today, that you have not found anything in my hand.” “He is a witness,” they replied.
The God and Father of the Lord Jesus, who is forever worthy of praise, knows that I am not lying.
Who is like the LORD our God, the One enthroned on high?

verses.text: My friends are my scoffers as my eyes pour out tears to God.

xrefs.text: During the days of Jesus’ earthly life, He offered up prayers and petitions with loud cries and tears to the One who could save Him from death, and He was heard because of His reverence.
I pour out my complaint before Him; I reveal my trouble to Him.
I could also speak like you if you were in my place; I could heap up words against you and shake my head at you.
In return for my love they accuse me, but I am a man of prayer.
But the scribes and Pharisees were filled with rage and began to discuss with one another what they might do to Jesus.

verses.text: Oh, that a man might plead with God as he pleads with his neighbor!

xrefs.text: Whatever exists was named long ago, and it is known what man is; but he cannot contend with one stronger than he.
But who are you, O man, to talk back to God? Shall what is formed say to Him who formed it, “Why did You make me like this?”
Woe to him who quarrels with his Maker— one clay pot among many. Does the clay ask the potter, ‘What are you making?’ Does your work say, ‘He has no hands’?
Yet I desire to speak to the Almighty and argue my case before God.
Let Him remove His rod from me, so that His terror will no longer frighten me.

verses.text: For when only a few years are past I will go the way of no return.

xrefs.text: But a man dies and is laid low; he breathes his last, and where is he?
As a cloud vanishes and is gone, so he who goes down to Sheol does not come back up.
Since his days are determined and the number of his months is with You, and since You have set limits that he cannot exceed,
When a man dies, will he live again? All the days of my hard service I will wait, until my renewal comes.
